product.retailSyncConfirmDescription: The retail price will update the product master and warehouse RRP. Choose what happens to store prices:
product.retailSyncStoresHelper: On: set every active store's retail price to the new price. Off: store prices stay unchanged. Whether stores are notified or need to relabel depends on "Generate price tasks" below.
product.retailGenerateTasksHelper: On: create price tasks for stores (a Relabel task if "Sync store retail prices" is also on, otherwise a Price change task). Off: stores aren't notified and no tasks are created; synced store prices are still pushed to HQ straight away, and shelf labels aren't changed.
